2. 2024-12-28 trips were lower than early/mid-December Saturdays, making 12-21 not a unique seasonal outlier [Q3 · sha256:506954e2783f6d90 · whybot.yellow_daily]

hypotheses.statement: Trips on 2024-12-21 were lower than the average of the other three Saturdays in December 2024.
hypotheses.refute_if: 2024-12-21 trips >= mean of other Saturdays, or difference is negligible (<5%).
hypotheses.status_reason: Trips on 2024-12-21 (131,279) were +0.15% vs the mean of other Saturdays (131,087), not lower by a meaningful margin (>5-10%). The premise of a reduction is false.

hypotheses.statement: Snowfall on 2024-12-21 suppressed trip demand relative to other Saturdays with no snow.
hypotheses.support_if: snow_mm > 0 on 2024-12-21 and snow_mm = 0 on all other Dec 2024 Saturdays; trips on 2024-12-21 are lower.
hypotheses.refute_if: snow_mm = 0 on 2024-12-21, or other Saturdays also had snow but trips were not similarly reduced.
hypotheses.status_reason: Although snowfall (46mm) occurred only on 2024-12-21, trips did not decrease relative to the baseline mean. The hypothesized suppression did not materialize in the aggregate data.

hypotheses.statement: A holiday on or near 2024-12-21 (e.g., Christmas week) altered travel patterns vs. other Saturdays.
hypotheses.support_if: A federal/state holiday falls on 2024-12-21 or adjacent weekdays, and trip pattern differs from non-holiday Saturdays.
hypotheses.refute_if: No holiday on 2024-12-21 or adjacent days; or holidays present on other baseline Saturdays too.
hypotheses.status_reason: No holidays on any of the four Saturdays. Holiday effect is not a factor.

hypotheses.statement: The pre-Christmas Saturday (21st) has intrinsically different demand than early/mid-December Saturdays, regardless of weather.
hypotheses.support_if: Historical pattern (if available) shows last Saturday before Christmas is lower; but no prior years in data. Instead, check if 2024-12-28 (post-Christmas) is also low, suggesting seasonal effect.
hypotheses.refute_if: 2024-12-28 trips are similar to 12-07 and 12-14, making 12-21 an outlier.
hypotheses.status_reason: 2024-12-28 shows a large seasonal drop (-42% vs early Dec), making it a poor baseline. 2024-12-21 is higher than 12-28 but lower than 12-07/12-14. Without pre-2024 data, cannot isolate pre-Christmas seasonal effect from weather. The baseline is contaminated.

hypotheses.statement: The mix of trip distances/fares shifted on 2024-12-21 (e.g., fewer short trips), indicating behavioral change beyond volume.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_trip_distance or avg_total_amount on 2024-12-21 differs significantly from other Saturdays, suggesting different trip purposes.
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount on 2024-12-21 are consistent with other Saturdays; only volume dropped.
hypotheses.status_reason: Avg trip distance on 12-21 (4.79) is notably higher than 12-07 (3.93) and 12-14 (4.27), suggesting fewer short trips. Avg fare slightly lower. This indicates a fare/distance mix shift consistent with snow altering trip purposes (e.g., fewer short hails, more essential/longer trips).

hypotheses.statement: The low trip count on 2024-12-21 is due to missing or incomplete data ingestion for that day.
hypotheses.support_if: Trip count is implausibly low (e.g., near zero or <50% of baseline) AND avg_total_amount/avg_trip_distance are NULL or extreme outliers.
hypotheses.refute_if: Trip count is reduced but avg_total_amount and avg_trip_distance are reasonable and consistent with other days.
hypotheses.status_reason: Data for 2024-12-21 is complete and plausible. No ingestion issues detected.
